description: PASS: the same typed digest reference as typed-ref-pass-01, carried as an entry in the `cpb-refs` COSE protected header parameter instead of the payload. Verification proceeds identically -- the algorithm operates on the reference's four members, not on which carriage mechanism transported them -- and produces the byte-identical recomputed digest.

verification.note: Byte-identical to typed-ref-pass-01: the reference's four members and the cited artifact are unchanged; only the transport (COSE protected header vs. payload) differs. §8.1/§8.4 apply without modification.

provenance: Derived from typed-ref-pass-01 (same cited_artifact and typed_reference) to demonstrate carriage-independence of verification, authored for the cpb-03-typed-refs-envelope revision. Not a fold of any external vector file.
